create_DataTransforms_pipeline: create a DataTransforms pipeline from a config dict to apply multiple transforms to AtomicData objects
run_ani1x_transform: run the ani1x_transform function to center a molecule in a periodic cell and add fixed atom flags
run_qm9_transform: run the qm9_transform function to center a molecule in a periodic cell and apply common transforms
run_decompose_tensor: run decompose_tensor to decompose a rank-2 tensor into irreducible representation components using Clebsch-Gordan matrices
run_ensure_tensor: run ensure_tensor to convert scalar or list attributes on an AtomicData object into flat PyTorch float tensors
